title: SJF without preemption
summary: Shortest job first: the shortest ready process runs to the end.
hints: Loop `N` times: among the processes that have ARRIVED (`arr <= t`) and are not done, pick the shortest duration; ties go to the earlier arrival, then to the one listed first.
If nobody has arrived yet, move the clock to the next arrival and look again. The process runs for its whole duration (nothing interrupts it).
